numerical_method: Source-reconstructed spherical nearest densified boundary vertex distances, never claimed equal to unpublished author CSVs. Internal ecological borders retained; WCMC native 30arcsec mountain-cell grid, zero inside classes 1-7, 255 is nonmountain background, not numeric mountain distance.
nodata: Use raster masks, explicit bounds and finite checks. Do not impute missing climate/TRI to zero or extrapolate from adjacent pixels.
outputs: Aggregated completeness/source receipts and hashes only. No IUCN-derived site grids, source ranges, raw UNEP data or pointwise features exported.
